sourceFile: 1. BRS-2015 Report Test New Bond G06-0003 Date 3.5.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the main bond comparison but has incorrect grouping and outcome calculations.
issues: SM/YOKE vision are outcome subgroups, not changed conditions.
Vision YOKE comparison uses wrong normal baseline row.
Vision NG counts/rates use defect columns inconsistently.
Separate glue/drop/tension rows are mixed into vision or raw measurement outcomes.
Function result should be treated as comparable/similar, not simply improved.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to New Bond G06-0003 vs Normal Bond G06-0002 only.
Rebuild vision outcomes by SM and YOKE with matched normal/test rows.
Use total NG and displayed rates consistently for each row.
Represent separate glue, tension, and drop as OK/pass outcomes with proper rows.
Revise function judgement to similar or no material difference using rows 76,78,85.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficiently grouped and some cited rows are misused.
